messages:
noah: RFC follow-up: propose a redispatch handshake for routers + quota service to avoid oscillation when soft-credits deplete. Idea: router asks Quota for a dispatch token with explicit outcome codes (ALLOW / REDISTRIBUTE / HOLD).

zara: Outcome codes good. What's HOLD mean? backoff suggestion?

noah: HOLD = short explicit retry-after + suggested backoff bucket. REDISTRIBUTE = route to named overflow pool (with cache_version) or fall back policy. ALLOW = go.

kevin: How do we prevent churn if routers ignore HOLD and keep hammering?

lee: Enforceability: quota replies include a signed nonce + TTL. Routers must present nonce to acceptors; quota keeps small revoke list. Also rate-limit HOLD responses per-tenant.

security-bot: Signed nonce helps prevent replay but be careful about clock skew and nonce storage.

noah: Example payload:
{ tenant, tokens, decision: "ALLOW|REDISTRIBUTE|HOLD", nonce, ttl, redirect_pool?, retry_after_ms? }

zara: Telemetry: decision_counts, hold_rate, redirect_latency_penalty. Add alert when hold_rate spikes > baseline.

kevin: Abuse vector: tiny repeated requests to harvest allowed nonces. Mitigation: min_token_size for ALLOW, require probe_eligibility for nonces.

lee: Operationally: make handshake opt-in per-tenant via config. Start with Dedicated customers. Keep default = legacy optimistic.

ops-bot: Added deploy checklist: /internal/checklists/redispatch-handshake

noah: Action items: I will write brief RFC addendum + sequence diagrams. Zara: draft telemetry panels. Kevin: abuse gating thresholds. Lee: nonce signing + storage design.

zara: Sync 11:00 tomorrow.
